title: 리빙메모리 핀보드 시네마틱 V1.2 (Source Gate Registration)
productJob: A cinematic living-memory pinboard: moments are pinned as cards on a Pearl-Ivory board (6 themes / 7 pins / 6 card styles) joined by a Living Thread with idle wobble and elastic reflow; moments support direct editing, WHY NEXT / next-moment / multi-chooser connections, and a Cinema mode with pause, resume, scrub and board re-entry. V1.2 shows real YouTube media via thumbnail-first loading and a youtube-nocookie embed viewer with an explicit 'YouTube에서 재생' fallback. Registration only — no product adoption implied.
